en: Smallest hero wielding the biggest missile launcher
Warhawk fires a rocket dealing [DAMAGE|CBASE,CR,WR] that also blasts him backwards.
cn: 尼尔发射出一枚火箭榴弹，造成[DAMAGE|CBASE,CR,WR]伤害，冲击力会将尼尔向后击退。

en: Warhawk targets up to three nearby locations before firing a missile towards each area. The missile deals damage in an area on impact and leaves behind a pool of fire that continuously deals damage and slows enemies inside. \n\n•Targets take 33% of the impact damage after the first missile hits.
cn: 尼尔瞄准附近最多三个位置，然后对每个区域发射一枚导弹。导弹落地时会造成范围伤害，然后留下一滩火焰，对内部的敌人造成持续伤害，并使其减速。\n•第一枚导弹命中后，目标受到33%的冲击伤害。

en: Warhawk targets up to three locations and fires a missile dealing [DAMAGE|CBASE,CR,WR] and leaving a pool of fire that slows and deals [DAMAGE_PER_SEC|CBASE,CR] per second.
cn: 尼尔瞄准最多三个位置发射导弹，造成[DAMAGE|CBASE,CR,WR]伤害。导弹在落地处留下一滩火焰，减速敌人，每秒造成[DAMAGE_PER_SEC|CBASE,CR]伤害。

en: Use Rocket Ride to zoom around the battlefield.
cn: 使用火箭后跃在战场中自由地穿梭。
